ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately a 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black pigmentation extends from the peduncle base in a V-shape; contiguous light-grey fields occupy the upper-outer lobes; heavy black mottling and stippling are concentrated along the lower trailing edges and inner margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate angle of 55 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire continuous linear boundary; peak-to-valley amplitude varies between 3 to 10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the proximal edge of both lobes, tapering into sharp points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized white-on-black circular clusters visible along the black pigmentation of the right lobe's trailing edge and within the central dark wedge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions (darker than background white field) visible on the upper-middle region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small jagged indentation or missing tissue notch at the far right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Numerous high-intensity specular highlights from water droplets covering the lower central region and base of the fluke, obscuring underlying pigmentation.
